text:
No ethnic group is known for loving dancing more than others, and no group is one where everyone loves it, since enjoyment varies from person to person within every community. Dance is central to some traditions, such as Yoruba cultures in West Africa, Andalusian flamenco (shaped in part by Romani communities), and Irish step dancing. Ask about a specific tradition and I can say more about its dances and their role in community life.

CONFIDENCE: 85
